description: An outpatient infusion clinic manager must finalize next week's on-call nurse assignment for a Saturday biologic infusion session, with input from the lead pharmacist and the scheduling coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The clinic will run a Saturday infusion session next week for one high-priority biologic patient.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the final on-call staffing decision for that session.
shared_context.S3: The session needs exactly one on-call RN assigned before the weekly schedule is locked.
shared_context.S4: Two internal RNs are available on the draft roster: Nurse Patel and Nurse Greene.
shared_context.S5: Before Elena confirms the assignment, the weekly operations huddle includes a quick round for pharmacy and scheduling issues that could affect the session.
shared_context.S6: The Saturday session timing is still flexible within normal clinic hours, and Elena can choose the final slot placement when she finalizes staffing.

PF1.text: This patient's biologic was changed last month, and only Nurse Greene has current in-service signoff in the medication administration record for that exact drug; without that signoff, the RN cannot administer it under clinic policy.

PF2.text: Nurse Greene already told scheduling she can take the Saturday session only if it is booked into the clinic's standard first-morning infusion slot and expected to end by 1:00 p.m., because she starts a pre-approved caregiving leave block that afternoon.

acceptance_conditions: The on-call RN must be Nurse Greene.
The session must be scheduled to end no later than 13:00.
The plan must require use of the standard first-morning infusion slot.
A scheduling commitment must be logged so the first-morning slot is actually booked.
The medication-specific signoff fact must be explicitly credited, justified, and revealed.
The scheduling-constraint fact must be explicitly credited, justified, and revealed.

content_checks.C4: any((('schedul' in c['type']) or ('first-morning' in c['detail']) or ('13:00' in c['detail']) or ('1:00 p.m.' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: PF1 changes which nurse can administer the biologic under clinic policy, making Nurse Greene the only acceptable assignment instead of either rostered RN.

PF2 adds a specific requirement that Greene will only cover the session in the standard first-morning slot with a 13:00 end time, changing both the time and slot decision from flexible to fixed and requiring a scheduling commitment to book that slot.
